competition.subject: QNTMJAM: Your competition application is pending approval
competition.textIntro:
Your application is pending approval.

Thanks for applying to the QuantumJam Quantum Computing Competition. Your team was registered successfully and is currently under review. We'll email you to let you know whether your application was approved before November 21st.
competition.textDisclaimer: Important: the event's date, time, and location are still subject to confirmation. Your team's participation isn't confirmed until you receive approval by email.
competition.calloutTextHtml: Thanks for applying to the QuantumJam Quantum Computing Competition. We're reviewing your application and will email you to let you know whether it was approved before November 21st.
competition.disclaimerHtml: The event's date, time, and location are still subject to confirmation. Your team's participation isn't confirmed until you receive approval.
